description: Safely create, update, validate, preview and publish/schedule Progressive CMS content through public machine contracts (REST/MCP/CLI/.pcpub). Discovery-first; CLI for long deterministic workflows; .pcpub artifact mode for bulk/offline authoring; no direct DB; no Core patches.
entry_workflow: Read supplied docs index, confirm target/version/scopes and bootstrap.
Check this delivered manifest with the actual resolver; stop if incompatible.
Declare Content Types and bodyPolicy before theme/content; arrange required bounded reload.
Author only declared fields/registered blocks, strict nested RichText v2 and independent Block Document v1.
Use fresh draft and CAS, validate, inspect preview and SEO, then seal.
Publish only with permissions and task authorization; verify public HTML and eventual Search.
Verify editor can save, preview, seal and publish a subsequent revision.
